response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) as avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), baseline_stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as baseline_val FROM status_averages), qualified_with_baseline AS (SELECT sa.brokrepstat, sa.avg_modelconf, bs.baseline_val FROM status_averages sa CROSS JOIN baseline_stats bs WHERE bs.baseline_val IS NOT NULL AND sa.avg_modelconf > bs.baseline_val), qual_mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as qual_mean_val FROM qualified_with_baseline) SELECT qb.brokrepstat, qb.avg_modelconf, qb.avg_modelconf - qb.baseline_val, qb.avg_modelconf / qm.qual_mean_val FROM qualified_with_baseline qb CROSS JOIN qual_mean_calc qm WHERE qb.baseline_val IS NOT NULL AND qm.qual_mean_val IS NOT NULL
